question: How should the overly narrow and wrong SOC/capacity intervals be repaired?
finding: At the fixed7200s prefix, reevaluating the complete nonlinear likelihood largely corrects the capacity center while retaining almost the same capacity local SD. SOC center also improves and its local SD is about2.10 times larger. Select joint evidence-retention/replacement work, not a blanket width multiplier.
support_reference_decision: GO as an exact single-bound affine reference; NO-GO as a standalone historical SOC/Q remedy or an unbudgeted nonlinear streaming implementation.
